# Closed read strategy — actual evidence / source boundary

Actual attempt002 closed-preflight.json: normal mode=ro raised `unable to open database file` before any schema row; DB1798144B SHA403c09df33b937a242599ce556153bf164d4f456e9cbcf21a94d976d129409e8 and stat unchanged, no WAL/SHM/holders/old actors, main header read/write mode2/2. This is a reader/setup failure, no evidence of product schema failure or recovery damage. No App ran in002.

SQLite documents that WAL read-only opening still needs existing WAL/SHM, ability to create them, or immutable mode. WAL mode persists in the main file, even when the last connection removed side files. Thus ordinary read-only flags do not guarantee side-file-free initialization. The exact VFS/permission errno that prevented normal-ro initialization here was not captured; don't claim that every readonly open with absent WAL must fail.
Sources: [SQLite WAL read-only](https://sqlite.org/wal.html#read_only_databases), [SQLite URI immutable option](https://sqlite.org/uri.html#uriimmutable). Official pages were read only; no package/model/App traffic was executed.

003 uses immutable **only** under root-authorized closed/no-WAL/no-SHM/no-holders conditions, before/after exact dev/ino/mtime/size/SHA checks. Any WAL/SHM, even zero bytes, rejects before open; no fallback can ignore it. Reader uses mode=ro&immutable=1 and query_only. It never creates/deletes side files or checkpoints/writes source. It checks actual table_info columns before dependent SELECTs. Root's App may perform normal recovery on later startup; agent has not opened SQLite.

This is not a normal App exit assertion for001. Original001 normalExit absent and original002 reader failure remain intact. Only old PID absence is reused. Same project/Task/HOME/Store and one fresh filename002 are retained. No re-seed or new task. Owner/park-role, raw-beforeassert, body-focus Escape and independent normal quit flows are unchanged from002.

Commands (root only): closed-preflight.py then run.mjs in browser-esc-driver-003. New output browser-esc-run-003 is exclusive, must not pre-exist.
